name: Paperclip
description: Paperclip is an open-source orchestration platform for managing autonomous AI agent teams with goals, routines, governance, and a browser-based control plane.

notes.text: Open the web interface and register the first user after installation. Paperclip is configured in authenticated private mode for LAN access.
Persistent Paperclip runtime data is stored in `/opt/paperclip-data`, while the application code lives in `/opt/paperclip`.
Update `PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL` in `/opt/paperclip/.env` if you later place Paperclip behind a reverse proxy or custom hostname.
Codex and Claude Code are preinstalled. Because the Paperclip service runs as root, authenticate them as root inside the container so Paperclip can reuse those credentials.

For Codex, run `codex` and choose ChatGPT login for interactive use, or use API-key authentication for more programmatic workflows. Claude Code can be authenticated by running `claude` and using `/login`, or by providing Anthropic API credentials.
